notes.title: Bundle Release: Get All Our Studio's Roguelikes at Once!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that you can now purchase (or complete your collection of) all three of our roguelikes at a significant discount. This bundle might interest those who want to track the progress of our tiny studio over the years. If you particularly enjoy any of the games, please don't hesitate to leave a review on its page. This helps us tremendously and shows us that people want more games like it.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43539/Think_and_Watch/

Meanwhile, we are working on something very secret, so shhh... Stay tuned!

notes.title: Version 1.0 and a new trailer
notes.notes: Today we have a new trailer about our game on the game page. We also have left early access - enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Small balance patch
notes.notes:
-Now, you can gain much more "free" gold and mana in the early zones and less in higher. Gold mines and mana pools provide your primary income in higher zones.
-You need 500 mana to gain the next level. 
-Now upgrade cost for shelter is 100 gold's, but it will triple the growth of that shelter.

notes.title: Today's game update: leaders with different traits, gold mines, mana pools, etc.
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the most significant update after early access (already in-game)
- Now, you can choose a leader who impacts all your match. The default hero is the keeper, and he will increase the health of your troops. The game also has assassin and necromancer: you'll have to beat it on a few difficulty levels to play them.
- Now, after defeating enemies, you have a choice: build a shelter for creature growth, build a gold mine or build a mana pool - to gain gold or mana every turn. Mana in our game help to improve the level of your leader.
- We updated the in-game help section to reflex these changes. 
- We also made a few balance changes for new rules. We will continue to monitor the balance and refine it in the future. 
- Different other improvements (UI, graphical, bugs, etc.)...
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The first update after the early access launch and a few words about plans.
notes.notes:
First of all, we want to thank everyone who tried our game. We hope you enjoyed it, and we will try to make it more exciting with future updates.

Today there are several updates in the game that prepare the game for a larger one.

The main innovation of today (except for different improvements for UI and in-game help) is that the player now gets more control over the growth of his creatures. Players can upgrade each hideout once - right-click on it to do that. Yes, now there is an additional use for gold in the game - you have to distribute it between improvements to attack creatures and increase their growth. Don't worry. We have increased the income so that there is enough gold for all this :)

It gives you much more choice than before, but this is only the first step. We've already started working on a big update. With its introduction, heroes will appear in the game. And they will influence the style of the entire match. (We are planning a keeper, mage, and necromancer). 

You will unlock new heroes (and difficulties) by completing maps for the previous ones. Each hero will have a trait that affects their playstyle.

But that's not all - we plan to give players even more choice. After defeating the enemy creatures, you will have additional options except building a shelter, for example, creating a gold mine or an altar (more details later).

Thanks again to all those who follow our game, bought it, or managed to play it. Special thanks to those who left a review on the game page in the store. If you like the game, this is the best way to influence its development.

We are looking forward to talking with you about future updates!
